NpmSetup.npmDescription: Creates the npm repository for the tenant under the installed GitHub account or organization, as the bot. If a repository with the same name already exists and the bot can access it as a public repository, setup uses that repository instead of creating a new one. Setup also registers the release flow in the npm repository.
NpmSetup.templateDescription: Creates the workflow template repository for the tenant under the installed GitHub account or organization, as the bot. If a repository with the same name already exists and the bot can access it as a public repository, setup uses that repository instead of creating a new one. Setup also registers the shared format, type check and build workflow in the workflow template repository.
NpmSetup.title: npm repository setup
NpmSetup.unlinkConfirmDescription: This unlinks {npmRepository} and {templateRepository}. The repositories themselves are not deleted on GitHub.

NpmSetup.willOverwrite: The existing repository {fullName} will be overwritten and used
